title: C Examples
description: Use these examples with the setup steps in their lessons. These technologies need tools on your computer and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: C: Print a greeting
examples.description: stdio.h gives us printing tools. puts prints text and moves to a new line. The main function is where the program begins.

examples.title: Undefined Behaviour and Common Bugs
examples.description: Follow the undefined behaviour and common bugs lesson to set up this example. Read the code, then change one small value and try it on your computer.
examples.output:
$ gcc -Wall -Wextra -std=c17 -O0 overflow.c -o overflow && ./overflow
1
$ gcc -Wall -Wextra -std=c17 -O2 overflow.c -o overflow && ./overflow
0
$ gcc -std=c17 -g -fsanitize=undefined overflow.c -o overflow && ./overflow
overflow.c:6:14: runtime error: signed integer overflow: 2147483647 + 1 cannot be represented in type 'int'
1
